# busbar_config (Resource)

A GitOps singleton that owns the running busbar config and applies it wholesale (POST /api/v1/admin/config/apply). Manage at most ONE of these per gateway. The document is the full JSON config payload busbar boots from ({"config": {...}, "providers": {...}}); applying it bumps config_version. Full documents are live-only and revert to disk plus overlay on reload or restart; persist changes in config.yaml. The gateway must allow mutations with a writable overlay. Destroying this resource is a no-op on the gateway (there is no unapply); it only drops Terraform's tracking.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# GitOps singleton: apply the whole running config document. Manage AT MOST ONE
# busbar_config per gateway. The document is the JSON payload busbar boots from,
# an envelope of { config = {DeployCfg}, providers = {name = ProviderDef} }.
#
# Full config applies are live-only: they revert to disk plus overlay on reload
# or restart. Persist the source document in config.yaml. Destroying this resource is a
# no-op on the gateway (there is no "unapply"); it only drops Terraform's tracking.
resource "busbar_config" "running" {
  document = jsonencode({
    config = {
      models = {
        "claude-sonnet" = { provider = "anthropic", max_concurrent = 8, max_requests = -1 }
      }
      providers = {
        anthropic = { api_key = { env = "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" } }
      }
      auth = {
        chain = ["keys"]
        admin_auth = [{ "admin-tokens" = { token = { env = "BUSBAR_ADMIN_TOKEN" } } }]
      }
    }
    providers = {
      anthropic = { protocol = "anthropic", base_url = "https://api.anthropic.com" }
    }
  })
}

output "config_version" {
  value = busbar_config.running.config_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `document` (String, Sensitive) The full config apply document as a JSON string: {"config": {DeployCfg}, "providers": {name: ProviderDef}}. The `config` key is required; `providers` is optional. This is the write model (the boot-file shape), NOT the redacted read projection returned by GET /config.

### Read-Only

- `config_version` (Number) The monotonic config version after the last apply. Process-local; resets to 0 on gateway restart.
- `id` (String) Fixed singleton id (always "config").

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The config singleton has a fixed import id. The document is not recoverable
# (GET /config is a redacted projection), so supply the matching `document` in
# your configuration after import; only config_version is read live.
terraform import busbar_config.running config
```
